text.p: This is how major world bond markets were trading in late European business on Thursday.

GERMANY - Bund futures slip just before the close to end solidly lower. Dip in Treasury market behind the fall. Market watching Dublin ECOFIN meeting, Trichet comments from Bonn. The March Bund future on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) was trading at 99.65, down 0.31 from Wednesday's settlement price.

BRITAIN - UK gilts dropped sharply in late trading on profit-taking and continuing domestic political concerns ahead of the New Year. CBI output data were generally supportive. Gilt/bund spread at 10 years widened to 189 basis points. The March long gilt future on LIFFE was trading at 108-16/32, up 25/32 from Wednesday's settlement price.

FRANCE - December bond future off in narrow range, Bunds, US bonds set tone. Survived tests of 128.10/12. PIBOR up ahead of Chirac speech, after BoF member comments. 10-yr spd widens. The December notional bond future on the MATIF in Paris settled at 128.18 down 0.10 from Wednesday's settlement price.

ITALY - Italian debt markets took harder fall than other bond markets ending around 40 basis points down with market unable to stamp its own character on trade, taking cue from others. Lira remains soft close to central parity vs mark. The March bond future on LIFFE was trading at 127.19 down 0.61 from Wednesday's settlement price.

UNITED STATES - U.S. Treasuries dip, but still higher in late morning trade. Profit-taking, hedging with corporate supply weighs on mkt. Trading said dealer-driven, with no retail flows visible. Most action seen in 10-,30-yrs. Yield curve seen flattening. Fundamentals still overshadowed by negative technical factors.The March Treasury bond future on the Chicago Board of Trade was trading at 112-20/32, down 09/32 from Wednesday's settlement price. The long bond was quoted to yield 6.62 percent.

JAPAN - Japanese government bond futures ended down but off lows. Sentiment dampened by a local financial daily report quoting BOJ official as saying central bank may alter monetary policy before assessing impact of consumption tax hike from April 1997. In after hours trading the March future on LIFFE was trading at 125.02, up 0.38 from Wednesday's settlement price on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

EUROBONDS - The primary market saw the typical end-of-year inactivity on Thursday. Morgan Stanley added 120 million marks to its April 2012 Brazil Repackaged bonds. Eurofima set a 500 billion lira August 2006 FRN. UBS led an 80 million stg three-tranche asset-backed FRN.
